notes:
- The main game map is now enhanced by the minimap markers and filters!
- The main map now has filter toggle buttons on the side for control of what you see in both the main map and minimap.
- The current Heroic Bonus Dungeon is now visible at the bottom left corner of the main map.
- Hovering a map marker shows the marker details and distance, just like with the minimap.
- Added a new option to rescale main map markers.
- Added a new option to allow character movement while the main map is open.
- Removed filter settings in the mod settings menu, as they are all controlled from the main map now.
